content.text: The maximal-doc test exceeded the 1024-record cap (my bug). Let me fix it to maximise output within the caps:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
src = open('tests/test_stress.py').read()
start = src.index("records = []\n# 64-hop CNAME chain")
end = src.index("# --- whole-document garbage")
new = '''records = []
# 8 zones: each has a 63-hop CNAME chain plus a 64-record terminal RRset
for zi in range(8):
    for i in range(63):
        records.append(rec('n%d.z%d.test.' % (i, zi), 'CNAME', 'n%d.z%d.test.' % (i + 1, zi)))
    for j in range(64):
        records.append(rec('n63.z%d.test.' % zi, 'TXT', 'v' * 256))
c.check('records used %d <= 1024' % len(records), len(records) <= 1024, len(records))
zones = [{'origin': 'z%d.test.' % zi, 'records': [r for r in records if r['owner'].endswith('.z%d.test.' % zi)]}
          for zi in range(8)]
zones.append({'origin': 'chain.test.' if False else 'alt.test.', 'records': []})
doc = {'zones': zones,
       'profiles': [prof('p%d' % i, 64) for i in range(8)],
       'queries': [query('q%d' % k, 'n%d.z0.test.' % (k % 3), 'TXT', k + 1) for k in range(20)],
       'observations': [{'id': 'o%d' % o, 'query': 'q0', 'profile': 'p%d' % (o % 8),
                         'result': {'status': 'response', 'rcode': 'NOERROR',
                                    'answer': [rec('e%d.f.example.' % j, 'TXT', 'w' * 256)
                                               for j in range(128)]}} for o in range(64)]}
raw = json.dumps(doc).encode()
rc, out, err, rss, elapsed = run_measure(raw)
print('maximal document: in=%d out=%d rss=%.0fMiB %.2fs' % (len(raw), len(out), rss, elapsed))
c.check('maximal document accepted', rc == 0 and out.startswith(b'{"runs":'), '%r %r %r' % (rc, out[:80], err[:200]))
c.check('output under 32MiB cap', 0 < len(out) < 32 << 20, len(out))
c.check('stderr empty', err == b'', err[:200])
c.check('peak child RSS under 512MiB', rss < 300, rss)
c.check('runtime under 30s', elapsed < 25, elapsed)
if out.startswith(b'{"runs'):
    parsed = json.loads(out)
    biggest = max(len(r['answer']) for r in parsed['runs'])
    print('largest answer in a run: %d records' % biggest)

'''
open('tests/test_stress.py','w').write(src[:start] + new + src[end:])
print('patched')
PYEOF
python3 tests/test_stress.py; echo "exit=$?"
